Trigger You would gain Grace or Cinders while already at your cap.

When you would gain Grace or Cinders while already at your cap, the point is not lost. Instead, choose one: regain Hit Points equal to twice your level; end one condition of your level or lower affecting you or an ally you can touch; or gain a +2 status bonus to your next check made within the minute. The overflow point itself is still spent — you gain a boon, not the resource.
